summary: Frontend E2E testing of the unified 'Tipi di azienda' list and inline quick-create flows (Companies + Deals) in org Nova Events. Verified: (1) Impostazioni page shows the new 'Tipi di azienda' section with add-input-tipi_azienda / add-button-tipi_azienda / rename-tipi_azienda-* / remove testids. (2) Aziende -> Aggiungi azienda -> field-tipo is a dropdown backed by settings.tipi_azienda with field-tipo-add-option '+ Aggiungi nuova tipologia' -> inline input field-tipo-add-input + field-tipo-add-confirm creates the value, auto-selects it, keeps the CompanyDialog open with data preserved. Tipo and Settore remain separate fields. (3) Sponsor & Partner -> Nuova trattativa: deal-dialog field-tipo now uses the SAME list as tipi_azienda (Azienda/Espositore/Istituzione/Partner/Sponsor + added TEST_Tipologia1) and NO LONGER shows the legacy lowercase list (sponsor/partner/fornitore/prospect). '+ Aggiungi nuova tipologia' works from inside the deal dialog too. (4) deal-dialog field-azienda_id has '+ Aggiungi nuova azienda' (add-entity-azienda_id) which opens CompanyDialog OVER the deal dialog; after company-save the CompanyDialog closes, the deal-dialog is still open, the just-created company is auto-selected in field-azienda_id, and other fields (Tipo=Sponsor, Valore=1234) remain intact. (5) Duplicate name check works: creating a company with an existing name triggers window.confirm 'Esiste già un'azienda "...". Vuoi crearla comunque?' before creating. (6) No regressions on other EntityManagers: Attivita and Follow-up dialogs still open and render correctly.

minor.issue: Backfill in default_settings/get_settings only adds MISSING KEYS to an existing settings doc; it does NOT merge missing VALUES into an existing list. For org 'nova_events_test_org' the settings.tipi_azienda already existed with only 5 values [Azienda, Espositore, Istituzione, Partner, Sponsor], so the newer defaults 'Fornitore' and 'Prospect' are NOT present. The review request explicitly expects all 7 values (Azienda, Espositore, Fornitore, Istituzione, Partner, Prospect, Sponsor) in the org. Fix by either (a) enhancing backfill to merge missing default values into existing lists (union-preserve-order) at least for tipi_azienda, or (b) explicitly patching the Nova Events seed so tipi_azienda contains all 7.

issues: Uses the browser native date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar component. Pre-existing, not introduced by this iteration.
Iubenda cookie banner still overlays the bottom of the page on first visit; can partially cover 'Salva' on some dialogs on smaller viewports.

action_items: Backend: make settings backfill merge missing default VALUES for tipi_azienda into existing org settings, or run a one-off migration/seed on nova_events_test_org to add 'Fornitore' and 'Prospect'. The tipi_azienda list must contain all 7 values as per spec.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_settings backfill logic is intentional (only missing keys) but the review request treats 'Tipi di azienda' as canonical and expects all 7 defaults visible for existing orgs; add a values-level backfill for the newly-introduced list only (idempotent).

crm.jsx Field for plain select uses ADD_ENTITY sentinel value '__add_entity__'. If a real option ever has that literal value, it would collide - low risk, but a safer sentinel or Symbol wrapping would be more defensive.

SettingSelect.jsx doAdd re-fetches /settings and PUTs the whole document; two rapid parallel adds could race and drop one. Consider a dedicated POST /api/settings/{key}/values endpoint or optimistic concurrency.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the new unification/quick-create flows; 1 data/seed issue on tipi_azienda content

Nova Events companies list has an extra TEST_CRMCo_<timestamp> record from this iteration. All unified 'Tipo azienda' UI wiring (SettingSelect+EntityDialog entityCreators) works as designed.
rca of the issue: Fornitore/Prospect not shown because default_settings() was updated to include those defaults after the org's settings document was created; get_settings() only backfills missing top-level KEYS, not missing VALUES within existing lists, so pre-existing tipi_azienda lists are never enriched. Mitigation: change get_settings to also union defaults[key] into existing list values for a curated set of keys (at minimum tipi_azienda), or update the Nova Events seed script to $addToSet the missing values.
